scripts.name: Get-SystemDiagnostics.ps1
scripts.synopsis: Baseline system diagnostics (OS, RAM, disk, uptime).
scripts.description: Collects OS, memory, disk and uptime for first-line triage. Runs locally and returns a structured PowerShell object (one row per item) that you can pipe to Export-Csv via the -ExportCsv parameter, or display directly. Use -Verbose for step-by-step progress. Strictly read-only — it inspects the system and never changes configuration.
scripts.permissions: Standard local read access (Administrator recommended for full event/registry visibility)
scripts.modules: Built-in Windows PowerShell modules (no install required)
scripts.returns: A structured report (one row per matching item), pipeable to Export-Csv.
